name: FlowMatch scheduler (DiffSynth-style)
plain: Linear sigmas from a denoise-scaled start, bent by the flow shift. Options match a training-repo scheduler: inverse, extra_one_step (drops the last point) and reverse. No 0 is ever appended: with extra_one_step off the list ends at the shifted sigma_min.
math:
σ₀ = σmin + (σmax−σmin)·denoise. σ=linspace(σ₀, σmin, n+1) ([:-1] if extra_one_step).
σ' = shift·σ/(1+(shift−1)σ). reverse: 1−σ'. inverse: flip before shift.

props.params: num_inference_steps, denoising_strength, shift, sigma_max, sigma_min, inverse_timesteps, extra_one_step, reverse_sigmas

providers.author: BigStationW
